{{Quote|You sound like a festerin' jizz-box. I got a festerin' jizz-box right over there in that corner.|The assistant manager of the Wookiee's Codpiece, to C-3PO|<ref name="Planet" />}}
The '''Wookiee's Codpiece''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nim Drovis]]. The walls were lined with a [[Color/Legends|pink]], plush material.<ref name="Planet" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' is set thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] auditioned to perform [[Music/Legends|music]] in the Codpiece so he could earn money to leave the planet with his [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The [[Unidentified assistant manager|assistant manager]] of the Wookiee's Codpiece compared his performance to that of a festering [[jizz-box]] and turned him away, saying that the cantina already had one of those in a corner.<ref name="Planet" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wookiee's Codpiece was briefly mentioned in ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', a [[1997]] novel by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="Planet" />
